testo: Hi! We've seen each other often over these months: we've become true friends! Unfortunately, the Premium trial period is coming to an end. To keep continuous automatic USB backups and advanced features active, we offer two transparent plans: €20.00 for 6 months or €35.00 for 1 year. But we want to tell you from the bottom of our hearts: if you choose not to activate Premium, you will NOT lose anything saved on your computer. Your inventory stays right there, and the app will continue to work for free in its basic features, because our main goal is to help you reduce food waste!
